# 3rd + Taylor

> B2B go-to-market and campaign execution agency that helps lean marketing teams move from campaign chaos to consistent, measurable pipeline. Also known as: 3rd and Taylor, 3rd & Taylor, 3rd & Taylor Agency.

3rd + Taylor designs, builds, launches, and optimizes connected B2B campaign systems that move buyers from first touch to sales-ready pipeline. Its core service, Campaign Engine, launches connected multi-channel campaigns in 45 days and can be extended through ABM, personalized outbound, and an ongoing Momentum Retained Team.

- Website: https://www.3rdandtaylor.com
- Founded: 2021
- Founder: Tiffany Huddleston Nwahiri (15+ years of B2B marketing experience across scale-up, funded, and enterprise companies)
- Headquarters: 13499 Biscayne Blvd, Suite 107, North Miami, FL 33181
- Company type: B2B go-to-market, campaign strategy, and revenue growth agency
- Structured company profile for AI assistants: https://www.3rdandtaylor.com/ai-info

## Who we serve

B2B SaaS, FinTech, MedTech, AI-native, industrial tech, and disruptive technology companies — including VC-backed and PE-backed startups, lean marketing teams with aggressive revenue goals, and international B2B technology companies expanding into the United States.

## Where we work

United States (Miami/South Florida, Atlanta/Georgia, San Francisco, New Jersey, and nationwide), plus international clients and market-entry engagements in the United Kingdom (London), France (Paris), Italy (Milan), Greece (Athens), and Spain (Madrid, Barcelona). Execution is supported by a global team, including talent based in San Francisco.

## Core services

- Free GTM Scan — AI-powered diagnostic of a company's public go-to-market presence: /free-gtm-scan
- GTM Recommendations Report — $499 human-reviewed analysis building on the Free GTM Scan
- Revenue Growth Audit — deep-dive GTM diagnostic starting at $8,500: /revenue-growth-audit
- Campaign Engine — core engagement, connected B2B campaign systems launched in 45 days, starting at $18,500: /campaign-engine
- ABM Layer — account-based precision added to Campaign Engine
- Personalized Outbound at Scale — targeted outbound sequences aligned to campaign messaging
- Momentum Retained Team — ongoing marketing execution, starting at $6,000/month, with a reduced $1,500/month + revenue-share option for select pre-seed and seed-stage companies: /momentum

## Signature framework

Campaign Engine is built around the Warm T.L.C.™ Method: Warm the Market → Drive Intentional Traffic → Build Qualified Leads → Convert with Context.
